name: button-group
purpose: A toolbar of icon actions that belong to one surface (a code panel, a table header, a preview), after Cloudscape's button group. Each item is an icon button that names itself in a tooltip: a plain action, an on / off toggle, or a menu of options. Items past `visibleCount` collapse into one More actions menu. The toolbar is one tab stop with roving focus, so a row of six icons costs the keyboard user one Tab, not six.
useWhen: A row of icon actions on one surface: Copy, Format, Wrap lines, Download above a code editor.
Compact actions in a panel header where labels would not fit, each explained by its tooltip.
A mix of actions and on / off view toggles (wrap lines, show whitespace) that sit together.
More actions than the space allows: keep the frequent ones visible and move the rest into the overflow menu with `visibleCount`.
avoidWhen: A choice of exactly one option among several (view mode, period) → use `toggle-group`.
One primary action with related alternatives → use `split-button`.
A single icon action → use `icon-button` (with a `tooltip`).
Page or form actions with text labels (Save, Cancel, Create) → use `button`s laid out by the page.
A long list of commands or navigation → use `dropdown-menu`.
related: icon-button` — every item renders one; ButtonGroup adds the toolbar role, roving focus and overflow.
toggle-group` — a radiogroup of mutually exclusive options; ButtonGroup toggles are independent (`aria-pressed`).
split-button` — one main action plus a menu, with a visible text label.
dropdown-menu` — the menu behind menu items and the More actions overflow.
tooltip` — the visible name of each icon.
code-editor` — the usual host of an editor toolbar (`toolbar` slot).
bestPractices: Give the toolbar an `aria-label` that names the surface ("Editor actions"), and every item a `label` that says what it does ("Copy code", not "Copy"). Write the kebab attribute (`aria-label`, `:aria-label` when the name changes, `aria-labelledby` when a visible heading already names the surface), never the camelCase `ariaLabel` attribute.

The `ariaLabel` prop is optional in the types on purpose: vue-tsc does not camelize `aria-*` attributes onto props, so a required `ariaLabel` made the obvious `aria-label="…"` fail to type-check in a fresh create-vue app. The lint rule `webkit/accessible-name` keeps the name required instead: it flags a `ButtonGroup` with neither `aria-label` nor `aria-labelledby`.
Keep the most used actions first; `visibleCount` moves the tail into More actions, never the head.
Use a toggle only for a state the user can see change (wrapped lines); flip `pressed` in your `@toggle` handler — the component never stores it.
Set `loading` on an action while its request runs instead of disabling the whole group.
Use `kind="transparent"` on a surface that already has a border (a panel header) and `outlined` on the canvas.
Do not mix text buttons into the group; a text action belongs beside it as its own `Button`.

props.name: items
props.doc: Actions, toggles and menus, in reading order.

props.name: ariaLabel
props.doc: Accessible name of the toolbar, written as the `aria-label` attribute. Empty only when `aria-labelledby` names the toolbar; then no `aria-label` renders.

props.name: visibleCount
props.doc: Items shown as buttons; the rest go into the More actions menu. Unset shows every item.

props.name: overflowLabel
props.doc: Label of the overflow button. Empty uses the locale catalog (`More actions`).

events.name: click
events.notes: An action or a menu option was chosen (from the bar or the overflow).

events.name: toggle
events.notes: A toggle was activated; `pressed` is the new state to store.

examples.name: Default
WithOverflow
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import ButtonGroup from '@aziontech/webkit/button-group'
  import { computed, ref } from 'vue'

  const pinned = ref(true)

  const items = computed(() => [
    { id: 'refresh', label: 'Refresh', icon: 'pi pi-refresh' },
    {
      id: 'pin',
      type: 'toggle',
      label: 'Pin to home',
      icon: 'pi pi-star',
      pressedIcon: 'pi pi-star-fill',
      pressed: pinned.value
    },
    { id: 'share', label: 'Share', icon: 'pi pi-share-alt' },
    { id: 'duplicate', label: 'Duplicate', icon: 'pi pi-clone' },
    { id: 'archive', label: 'Archive', icon: 'pi pi-inbox', disabled: true },
    {
      id: 'export',
      type: 'menu',
      label: 'Export',
      icon: 'pi pi-file-export',
      options: [
        { id: 'export-csv', label: 'Export as CSV' },
        { id: 'export-json', label: 'Export as JSON' }
      ]
    }
  ])
</script>

<template>
  <ButtonGroup
    :items="items"
    :visible-count="3"
    kind="outlined"
    size="small"
    aria-label="Record actions"
    @toggle="({ pressed }) => (pinned = pressed)"
  />
</template>
